title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Strikes 022 — Swing-Leg Strike / Support Re-entry Debt

tango_history.highest_value_visible_defect: K04-K06 striking thigh telescopes across the frame, making the knee contact read as limb-only reach instead of body-earned impact.
tango_history.concrete_same_body_correction: Pull the abstract contact corridor inward and re-author K04-K07 front-knee/front-foot endpoints so the pelvis remains visibly responsible for the strike while preserving distinct precontact, pinned contact, and authored peel.

tango_history.highest_value_visible_defect: The full-height abstract target persists after authored peel, so K08-K13 visually ghost the recovering body through a wall and muddy the strike-to-support handoff.
tango_history.concrete_same_body_correction: Restrict the abstract contact-plane witness to K04-K07 only; after the authored peel, remove that non-physical witness so the displaced footfall/support recovery can read without fake collision geometry.

tango_history.judgment: Contact corridor is body-earned and compact; K05-K06 pin the knee while root continues; K07 peels before the same leg converts to foot seek; K09-K10 make support re-entry a separate owed event; K11-K13 preserve torso overshoot, trailing-leg catch, and displaced gait recovery.

noodle_queen_final.taste: The strike is not an inserted pose; it steals time from locomotion and pays it back through the same leg.
noodle_queen_final.function: The contact, pin, peel, support probe/catch, overshoot, and gait re-entry are distinct authored causal states.
noodle_queen_final.contempt: Rejects free-attack bookkeeping: the knee does not get to hit and teleport back to idle.

principle.name: SWING_LEG_STRIKE_SUPPORT_REENTRY_DEBT
principle.pocket_rule: THE KNEE BORROWS A STEP. AFTER CONTACT, THE STRIKING LEG STILL OWES THE GROUND.
principle.fresh_interpretation: A forward-moving body substitutes a knee strike into an already-spent swing-leg phase instead of inserting a free attack beat. The support leg owns the root through precontact and impact; the knee pins briefly while pelvis and torso continue spending force; release peels the knee before the same leg extends toward its already-due footfall. Recovery completes only after that striking foot catches the root, torso overshoot is paid, the trailing leg re-enters, and the gait resumes at a displaced address.

compile.transition_policy: authored holds plus deterministic one-frame geometry connectors only when support/contact topology is unchanged; connectors may not invent support/contact/causal state

keys.name: OFFSET_STRIDE_READY
keys.causal_role: establish displaced traveling-ready silhouette with rear-biased support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root forward intent exists before the strike; no idle symmetry

keys.name: REAR_SUPPORT_LOAD
keys.causal_role: support leg sinks and owns the root while striking leg becomes the next swing phase
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root drops/back one cell as torso counter-rotates

keys.name: SWING_PHASE_COIL
keys.causal_role: substitute attack preparation into the already-free swing leg rather than adding a stop
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root advances while front knee folds behind pelvis and arms split for counterbalance

keys.name: PELVIS_DRIVE_BRIDGE
keys.causal_role: authored body-first bridge: pelvis commits before knee travels into target corridor
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root surges forward/up; front knee remains folded and withheld

keys.name: KNEE_PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: distinct precontact gap while rear support still owns the moving root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis advances; striking knee rises to within two cells of target while torso stays behind it

keys.name: KNEE_CONTACT_INSTANT
keys.causal_role: explicit knee contact instant; contact is not merely farthest reach
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root advances slightly while knee closes final gap

keys.name: PINNED_KNEE_BODY_OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: contact becomes a temporary constraint while pelvis and torso continue spending force through the pinned knee
keys.motion_arc_root_note: knee stays fixed; root advances/down and head overshoots, rear foot stretches behind

keys.name: AUTHORED_KNEE_PEEL
keys.causal_role: break knee contact before recovery; same leg immediately owes its interrupted footfall
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root keeps moving as knee peels down-left from target rather than reverse-interpolating

keys.name: STRIKING_FOOT_SEEK
keys.causal_role: former striking limb converts from weapon back toward future support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues forward; front knee falls and foot extends ahead/down without yet owning root

keys.name: FOOTFALL_PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: scheduled next support approaches but has not yet arrested the root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: front foot hovers one row above ground; root still carries impact overrun

keys.name: STRIKING_FOOT_CATCH
keys.causal_role: the striking leg pays its borrowed step by becoming the next support owner
keys.motion_arc_root_note: front foot catches at the scheduled beat; pelvis has not yet stacked above it

keys.name: TORSO_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: new support takes load while torso and arms overrun the catch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root passes over catch; head travels farther; rear leg releases and arms lag asymmetrically

keys.name: TRAIL_LEG_CATCH
keys.causal_role: trailing leg re-enters after the striking-foot catch, repaying support asymmetry
keys.motion_arc_root_note: rear foot lands behind while torso counter-swings back from overshoot

keys.name: DISPLACED_GAIT_REENTRY
keys.causal_role: recover into a new-address gait-ready state, not the original idle pose
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root remains displaced forward; opposite limb is already prepared for the next travel phase
